key.name: encoding-mode
key.description: Choose either Archive or Compress mode

key.name: target-size
key.description: Size in MB the video will be compressed to in Compress mode

key.name: downscale-factor
key.description: How many times smaller is the output resolution

key.name: prefix
key.description: Prefix prepended to output file(s)

key.name: output-path
key.description: Videos will be saved here by default. none will output the result next to the original video.

key.name: codec
key.description: Sets which video codec to use for encoding.

key.name: av1-preset
key.description: Lower value means better compression but longer encoding time

key.name: av1-crf
key.description: Quality level. Lower values increase quality and bitrate

key.name: av1-fgs
key.description: Enables film grain synthesis postprocessing filter.

key.name: av1-fgl
key.description: Level of film grain in shot.

key.name: av1-bd
key.description: Enables overlay frames for better details.

key.name: av1-psy
key.description: Enables psychovisual tuning (better for human eye), instead of PSNR (exact method).

key.name: av1-vb
key.description: Adaptively increases bitrate when needed.

key.name: hevc-preset
key.description: Higher value means better compression but longer encoding time

key.name: hevc-crf
key.description: Quality level. Lower values increase quality and bitrate

key.name: hevc-psy
key.description: Enables psychovisual tuning (better for human eye).

key.name: hevc-aq
key.description: Enables adaptive quantisation. Better quality in frames with more details.

key.name: hevc-ab
key.description: Enables adaptive B-frames. Inserts as much B-frames as needed for better compression.

key.name: vp9-preset
key.description: Lower value means better compression but longer encoding time

key.name: vp9-crf
key.description: Quality level. Lower values increase quality and bitrate

key.name: vp9-cpu
key.description: Amount of CPU used during encoding. Lower values mean better compression but longer encoding time.

key.name: vp9-ns
key.description: Sensitivity of the deblocking filter which removes encoding artifacts.

key.name: vp9-qs
key.description: 0 = best, 1 = realtime, 2 = good

key.name: vp9-tune
key.description: 0 = default, 1 = screen recording, 2 = film content

key.name: avc-preset
key.description: Higher value means better compression but longer encoding time

key.name: avc-crf
key.description: Quality level. Lower values increase quality and bitrate

key.name: avc-me
key.description: Enables better motion estimation. Good for better compression, but increases encoding time.

key.name: avc-aq
key.description: Enables adaptive quantisation. Better quality in frames with more details.

key.name: avc-ab
key.description: Enables adaptive B-frames. Inserts as much B-frames as needed for better compression.

key.name: avc-tune
key.description: 0 = film, 1 = animation, 2 = grain, 3 = stillimage
